work.title: Four cases that show how I think in product UI
work.subtitle: Explore problem → system → outcome.

featured.name: Workforce Platform
featured.summary: Shift planning, attendance, leave, calendars, and reporting for daily operational teams.
featured.problem: HR ops needed one interface for many roles: planners, managers, and staff — with calendars, tables, and forms that stay reliable under heavy daily use.
featured.system: Built complex frontend modules on Next.js App Router: FullCalendar + drag-and-drop planning, role-based UI, Redux Toolkit + TanStack Query, Ant Design, i18n, Storybook, and Jest coverage.
featured.outcome: A maintainable enterprise frontend for high-complexity workforce workflows — reusable UI, clear state boundaries, and documented components.

featured.name: Flight Booking Platform
featured.summary: Enterprise flight booking: search, passengers, payment, and booking management.
featured.problem: Multi-step booking had to stay consistent across search → passengers → payment inside a large Nx monorepo and shared design system.
featured.system: Shipped React UI for critical booking flows with Radix, Redux plugins, Storybook, and Module Federation pieces in the client SDK architecture.
featured.outcome: Reusable booking patterns and design-system components that keep business-critical journeys coherent across the monorepo.

featured.name: Auto Parts Commerce
featured.summary: Storefront plus admin: catalogue, cart, checkout, orders, and content.
featured.problem: Both a customer storefront and an operational admin — filters by vehicle make/model, payments, and content workflows in one monorepo.
featured.system: Delivered Next.js storefront and MUI admin in an Nx setup with NestJS API, Prisma/PostgreSQL, payments, OAuth, and order/content management flows.
featured.outcome: End-to-end product surface: purchase path and admin tooling as one coherent system.

featured.name: Agreements Platform
featured.summary: Multi-step agreement wizard with wallet auth, GraphQL data, and IPFS storage.
featured.problem: Creating and signing agreements is a long, fragile flow — wallets, validation, imports, and previews had to feel trustworthy, not noisy.
featured.system: Owned the large frontend: multi-step wizard, forms/validation, GraphQL client + codegen, wallet connectors, IPFS, plus the marketing site with motion.
featured.outcome: A product-grade wizard UX where blockchain is context — the real win is clarity through complex business steps.
